title: code metrics
description: Results of the declared checks on one commit. Never the check output or the diff: names, counts, guarded paths and a failure signature only. checks_passed and checks_total are required when run_status is ok (checked in code).

checks_declared.description: Every check declared at the merge-base, run or not. A run that left one out (--checks) is partial: it never verifies a completion.

prepared.description: What the verification worktree got before the checks ([verify]): the names of the copied files and whether prepare ran. Never their content.

environment.description: The run says nothing about the commit: the worktree could not be prepared, or every failing check failed the same way at the merge-base. run_status is error.

guard_weakened.description: A guarded file was weakened (lines deleted or changed, a skip marker added, a conftest.py changed) or a JUnit check ran fewer tests than it did at the merge-base (fewer_tests_checks). Tests only added are not.

guard_added_files.description: Guarded files that were added or only appended to.

fewer_tests_checks.description: The JUnit checks that ran fewer tests than at the merge-base, each compared with its own run there (tests_before and tests_after are the sums).

check_definitions.description: An implementer's own run (via): the hash of each check's definition that ran (cmd, junit, timeout). check verify counts the pass only under the same definition.

run_by.description: An implementer's own run (via): the agent, or the agent type the Bash hook saw, that ran it.
